theme.zen.name: Zen style
theme.zen.tagline: Vertical tabs, floating rounded page, colour-tinted spaces.
theme.firefox.name: Firefox style
theme.firefox.tagline: Tabs on top, separate tab strip, floating rounded tabs, violet accent.
theme.brave.name: Brave style
theme.brave.tagline: Chromium layout with Brave Leo colours and rounded tabs.
theme.chrome.name: Chrome style
theme.chrome.tagline: Tabs on top that merge into the toolbar, pill omnibox, ⋮ menu.
ob.title.import: Bring your stuff from another browser
ob.lead.look: Each style is modelled on a browser you know, and its colours and shapes were measured from the copy installed on this PC. You can change this any time in Settings.
ob.lead.updates: Drift runs on Chromium {chrome}. Google ships a new Chrome every 4 weeks, and Electron, Drift's engine, packages each new Chromium about every 8 weeks with security fixes in between. New engines reach you inside Drift updates, from the source you pick here.
set.title: Settings
set.spaceColors: Colour the window with each space
set.spaceColorsHint: Zen's signature tint. Turn off to keep the style's own accent.
set.verticalTabsHint: Tabs in a sidebar like Zen. Off puts them across the top, the way Chrome, Firefox and Brave do by default.
set.compactHint: Hide the sidebar until you point at the left edge (Ctrl+Alt+C).
set.languageHint: English and Hebrew are built in. Other languages download from the Drift project when you pick them.
set.languageOffline: Could not reach the language list. Built-in languages are still available.
set.restore: Reopen last session's tabs on startup
set.restoreHint: Pinned tabs and Essentials always come back.
set.adblockHint: EasyList, EasyPrivacy and uBlock filters, plus YouTube ad skipping. Use the shield in the address bar to pause it on a site.
set.sitePermissionsLead: Answers you asked Drift to remember. Anything not listed will ask again.
set.engineAlerts: Tell me when a newer Chromium is out
set.engineAlertsHint: Compares Drift's engine with the latest Electron and Chrome releases.
upd.githubBody: Recommended. Drift checks a GitHub repository for new releases.
upd.customBody: An https:// folder holding latest.yml and the installers.
upd.offBody: Never check automatically. You install new versions yourself.
upd.newer: A newer Chromium ({major}) is available. It reaches Drift as a new Drift version: from your update source when installed, or with npm run update-engine in development.
imp.none: No other browsers with data were found on this PC.
imp.zenBody: Spaces, pinned tabs, Essentials, open tabs, bookmarks and history
imp.zenSpaces: From Zen: bring spaces, pinned tabs, Essentials and open tabs
imp.zenSpacesHint: Tabs arrive unloaded and open when you click them.
imp.pinBar: Turn the bookmarks bar into pinned tabs
imp.pinBarHint: Adds a space with your bookmarks-bar sites pinned, like Arc does. Every bookmark is also searchable from the address bar.
imp.privacy: Passwords and cookies stay in the other browser: they are encrypted to it and Drift does not read them.
dl.title: Downloads (Ctrl+J)
set.colorThemeHint: Colours on top of the style you picked. The style still decides the layout.
set.sleepHint: Frees memory; a sleeping tab reloads when you open it. Tabs playing audio never sleep.
set.forceDarkHint: Uses Chromium's automatic dark rendering on sites without a dark theme. Applies after a restart.
set.googleHint: Sign in to use Gmail, YouTube and Drive in Drift. Chrome Sync isn't available: Google limits it to Chrome itself.
set.openIn: Sites that open in another browser
set.openInHint: Right-click a page and choose “Open page in” to add one.
menu.noPermissions: No permissions remembered for this site
menu.shieldsCount: {count} ads and trackers blocked on this page
updmsg.dev: App updates run in installed builds. In development, run "npm run update-engine" to move to the newest Chromium.
updmsg.repo: Enter the GitHub repository that publishes Drift releases (owner/name).
updmsg.url: Enter an https:// address for the update server.
updmsg.offline: Could not reach the release servers.
